title: Payroll roster and departures, January 2024 to June 2026
what_it_shows: 7 active employees by role: Owner-Manager, Assistant Manager, 2 Front Desk Clerks, Night Auditor, Head Housekeeper, Housekeeper and Laundry Attendant, all working in Florida; payroll runs biweekly; 3 employees left since January 2024, 2 of them in 2026 (last days in March and May 2026); employees clock in with a PIN on the time clock tablet

title: PMS user, role and MFA list
what_it_shows: Named PMS accounts in 3 roles (administrator, front office, housekeeping); housekeeping users see room status only; a new user has no access until a role is assigned; the 2 administrator accounts (Owner-Manager, Assistant Manager) sign in with an authenticator app with number matching; front office and housekeeping accounts sign in with a password only; the front office role includes the 'view full card number' permission

title: PMS security, logging and data settings
what_it_shows: Account lockout after repeated failed sign-ins (vendor default); minimum password length 8 characters; the activity log records user, action and time, including full card number displays and exports; the activity report has no saved review schedule; a feature to charge OTA virtual cards without displaying the number is available and off; purge settings for guest profiles, ID images and folios are off

title: PMS interface settings
what_it_shows: Interfaces to the door lock software, the dynamic pricing tool and 3 OTAs (through the channel manager); the lock and pricing tool interface credentials show no change since each interface was installed

title: Productivity suite user, mailbox, MFA and security settings
what_it_shows: 3 mailboxes: the Owner-Manager and Assistant Manager mailboxes and the suite administrator account use an authenticator app with number matching; a shared front desk mailbox is signed in with one password and no MFA, last changed in 2024; account lockout and sign-in logging on at vendor defaults; log retention and spam and malware filtering at the business plan defaults

title: Shared front desk mailbox folder summary
source_system: Productivity suite admin console (SYS-05), mailbox content summary
what_it_shows: A crew billing folder holds emails from crew companies dating from 2021 whose subjects and attachment names show card authorization forms; message contents were not opened at intake

title: Gateway merchant portal: devices, features, plan and users
what_it_shows: 2 countertop terminals enrolled in the gateway's P2PE solution since 2024, semi-integrated with the PMS; virtual terminal and pay-by-link features available and not used; the motel's plan includes pay-by-link at no added fee; 2 portal users: the Owner-Manager (MFA enrolled) and the Assistant Manager (no MFA enrolled)

title: Gateway transaction report by entry mode, July 2025 to June 2026
what_it_shows: About 13,800 card transactions under one merchant account: about 7,600 card-present on the P2PE terminals, about 2,400 keyed card-not-present through the PMS payment screen, about 2,100 OTA virtual cards charged through the PMS, and about 1,700 booking engine prepayments; about 38 transactions a day (about $2,800)

title: MSP device list, software inventory and build notes
source_system: MSP remote monitoring and management console
collected_by: Assistant Manager (Security and Privacy Lead), with the MSP lead technician
what_it_shows: 3 managed PCs: front desk PC, back office PC and the Owner-Manager's laptop, built from the MSP's standard image; the list has no payment terminals, tablets, network devices, CCTV recorder, lock encoder or SaaS services; the back office PC runs the door lock software and database and the lock vendor's remote support tool, installed as a service that starts automatically; the front desk PC runs a web browser, the PMS in the browser, the suite mail client and the key card encoder software

title: MSP device policy report
source_system: MSP remote monitoring and management console
collected_by: Assistant Manager (Security and Privacy Lead), with the MSP lead technician
what_it_shows: Front desk PC: one shared Windows account with automatic sign-in and no screen lock; back office PC: named accounts for the Owner-Manager and Assistant Manager; the back office PC and laptop lock after 10 minutes; staff have no local administrator rights; USB storage blocked on the 3 PCs; the PCs synchronize time with an internet time source; the laptop's host firewall is on by default and not enforced by policy

title: MSP device encryption report
source_system: MSP remote monitoring and management console
collected_by: Assistant Manager (Security and Privacy Lead), with the MSP lead technician
what_it_shows: Disk encryption reported on the Owner-Manager's laptop; not reported on the front desk PC or the back office PC

title: MSP monthly service report, June 2026
collected_by: Assistant Manager (Security and Privacy Lead), with the MSP lead technician
what_it_shows: Monthly operating system patching on the 3 PCs completed; antivirus current on the 3 PCs; nightly backup jobs completed; firewall firmware is updated during on-site visits

title: MSP antivirus console export
collected_by: Assistant Manager (Security and Privacy Lead), with the MSP lead technician
what_it_shows: Signature antivirus on the 3 PCs with automatic updates, weekly full scans, real-time scanning and automatic quarantine; alerts go to the MSP help desk queue, which is staffed in business hours; no endpoint detection and response agent

title: MSP network documentation, firewall settings and Wi-Fi configuration export
source_system: MSP network documentation and firewall management
collected_by: Assistant Manager (Security and Privacy Lead), with the MSP lead technician
what_it_shows: One business internet line; an MSP-managed firewall that blocks unsolicited inbound traffic; one office network holding both PCs, both terminals, the printer, the CCTV recorder and a staff Wi-Fi network for the tablets (WPA2 passphrase set in 2023); a separate guest Wi-Fi network on 8 access points with client isolation and internet access only, separated in 2023; firewall logs kept on the device for about 7 days and overwritten; firewall configuration backed up by the MSP

title: Backup console job history and settings
source_system: Cloud backup service console (SYS-09), viewed with the MSP
collected_by: Assistant Manager (Security and Privacy Lead), with the MSP lead technician
what_it_shows: Nightly jobs for the back office PC and the productivity suite completed from April to June 2026; 30 days of versions; immutable versions off; console sign-in requires MFA for named MSP technicians; the job history since setup in 2024 shows no restore jobs

title: MSP ticket history, July 2025 to June 2026
collected_by: Assistant Manager (Security and Privacy Lead), with the MSP lead technician
what_it_shows: Password reset requests for the shared mailbox and PMS users; a front desk PC replaced in 2025, with the ticket closed and no wipe or disposal record

title: MSP service contract
what_it_shows: Covers firewall and Wi-Fi management, patching and antivirus on the 3 PCs, and operation of the cloud backup; 4-business-hour response time; no recovery time commitment; the service list does not include vulnerability scanning, endpoint detection and response, or after-hours alert monitoring; no security or incident notice terms; firewall duties are not described

title: Merchant agreement
what_it_shows: One merchant account with the acquirer; the agreement requires PCI DSS compliance and yearly validation, and notice to the acquirer within 24 hours of a suspected compromise of card data

title: Acquirer PCI program notice
what_it_shows: Notice dated 2026-05-11 asks the motel to confirm its SAQ eligibility because the gateway reports keyed card-not-present transactions; the 2026 attestation of compliance is due 2026-12-31

title: 2025 SAQ P2PE and acquirer portal record
what_it_shows: A 2025 SAQ P2PE signed by the Owner-Manager and submitted in December 2025, with every requirement answered 'In Place'; the portal shows no ASV scan submissions

title: Document request response
source_system: Owner-Manager and Assistant Manager files; suite file store
what_it_shows: The request for written security policies, a PCI DSS scope document, a card data-flow or network diagram, an incident response plan, a contingency plan, a retention schedule, a risk assessment, a service provider list and training material returned none

title: Security and Privacy Lead designation letter
what_it_shows: Designates the Assistant Manager as Security and Privacy Lead and day-to-day PCI DSS contact, effective 2026-07-01

title: HR files: hiring checklist, handbook and background-check reports
what_it_shows: The hiring checklist includes a background check on front desk and night audit applicants through a background-check company; the reports are printed and filed in an office drawer with no disposal date; the employee handbook has one paragraph on confidentiality; no security or privacy training records

title: Accounting SaaS vendor payment list, July 2025 to June 2026
what_it_shows: Recurring payments to the PMS vendor, the payment gateway, the MSP (including the cloud backup), the door lock vendor (support invoices), the productivity suite vendor, the dynamic pricing tool vendor (since 2025-03), the background-check company, the payroll service, the accounting SaaS, the internet service provider, a website-builder service, the cyber insurer, the contracted bookkeeper and the contracted handyman; no other AI tool subscriptions

title: Accounting SaaS and payroll service security settings
source_system: Accounting SaaS and payroll service admin pages (SYS-08)
what_it_shows: Both vendors enforce MFA for every user, including the contracted bookkeeper's named user in the accounting SaaS; the time clock tablet uses PINs

title: FY2025 profit and loss
what_it_shows: Revenue of about $1.1 million: rooms about $1.04 million; lobby market, laundry and pet fees about $60,000; about $3,000 a day

title: PMS occupancy and stay statistics, July 2025 to June 2026
what_it_shows: About 10,300 room-nights at about 74% occupancy and an average base rate of about $95 plus a mandatory $6 nightly fee; about 5,900 stays; about 30% of room-nights from 14 crew accounts; about 16 arrivals a day, most between 3 p.m. and midnight; about 27 occupied rooms serviced a day

title: PMS vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report and PCI DSS attestation of compliance
what_it_shows: SOC 2 Type 2 report on Security and Availability for the 12 months ending 2026-03-31, unqualified opinion, one exception (a missed quarterly access review for vendor support staff, remediated); hosting provider carved out; five complementary user entity controls; stated RTO 4 hours and RPO 15 minutes; customers notified within 72 hours of a confirmed incident; database and card vault encrypted, TLS 1.2 or higher; configurable purge settings; no bridge letter; service provider AOC dated February 2026

title: SaaS vendor security documentation
source_system: Vendor websites and portals (productivity suite; backup service through the MSP)
what_it_shows: The productivity suite vendor and the backup service describe encryption of stored data and TLS for data in transit

title: PMS booking engine and fee configuration
what_it_shows: The booking engine payment page is hosted on the PMS vendor's own web address and the motel receives a token; the $6 property service fee is set as mandatory and included in the booking engine total since May 2025 (change log); the fee description lists Wi-Fi, parking and breakfast; the channel manager connects to 3 OTAs

title: Website capture and phone reservation script
source_system: Motel website (website-builder service); front desk script sheet
what_it_shows: The website's 'rates from' banner shows a base rate; 'Book now' links to the PMS vendor's booking page; the privacy statement is a website-builder template page; the front desk phone script quotes the base rate and mentions the fee only if the caller asks

title: Dynamic pricing tool account settings
what_it_shows: Machine-learning rate recommendations publish automatically to the PMS since 2025-03; no ceiling, floor or daily change limit set; no rule for a declared state of emergency; MFA available and off on the tool account

title: PMS vendor AI guest messaging offer
source_system: Owner-Manager's email inbox; PMS admin console
what_it_shows: PMS vendor email offering a free trial of its AI guest messaging add-on; the trial was not started; the PMS admin console lists the add-on as available and not enabled

title: Staff AI tool question
what_it_shows: Responses mention public generative AI chatbots used to draft emails or answer questions; the responses did not record how many staff use them or what was entered; no list of approved AI tools exists in the documents provided

title: Crew client vendor security questionnaire
what_it_shows: Questionnaire from the largest crew client, a regional utility line contractor (about 18% of room-nights), about its corporate card data and crew rosters (names, phone numbers, employee ID numbers); response due 2026-09-30; a self-assessment with a remediation plan is accepted

title: Crew account letters
what_it_shows: 14 crew account letters; crew companies pay by emailed card authorization forms, except 2 invoiced as business accounts; no consumer credit is extended

title: Cyber liability policy
what_it_shows: Cyber liability policy bought in 2025, with a 24x7 breach hotline and panel breach counsel and forensic firm; the policy requires notice through the hotline

title: Internet service contract
what_it_shows: One business internet line; no second line or failover service

title: Building hurricane checklist
what_it_shows: Covers storm shutters and a generator for the office and lobby; no steps for IT systems, the lock system or payments

title: Sample guest folio and terminal receipt
what_it_shows: Receipt and folio show only the last 4 digits of the card number; the folio shows the room rate, the $6 fee, taxes and the total

title: Vendor agreements folder
what_it_shows: Signed terms with the PMS vendor (the vendor keeps activity logs for the contract term), the gateway, the productivity suite (business plan terms), the dynamic pricing tool (subscription terms), the background-check company, the payroll service, the accounting SaaS and the 3 OTAs; the door lock vendor relationship rests on support invoices with no written remote access or incident notice terms; no gateway AOC or P2PE Instruction Manual on file

title: Door lock software system summary
source_system: Door lock software on the back office PC (SYS-06)
what_it_shows: 41 electronic locks (38 guest rooms, lobby side door, laundry, pool gate) and one USB key card encoder at the front desk; the lock software and its database run on the back office PC

title: Intake interview: front office processes
what_it_shows: Phone reservation and no-show card numbers are keyed into the PMS payment screen in the browser on the shared front desk PC, which is also used for email and web browsing; crew companies email card authorization forms, many with the card security code, to the shared mailbox; clerks print them into a crew billing binder at the front desk and key them into the PMS (about 700 charges a year); crew rosters arrive by email and are entered as PMS group blocks; clerks display OTA virtual card numbers in the PMS to check balances; nobody reviews the PMS activity report, sign-in logs or firewall logs; staff have had no security training or guidance on callers; paper is shredded in the back office cross-cut shredder; the lock vendor's technicians connect to the back office PC through their remote support tool with one password they share and no MFA

title: Intake interview: ownership, history and operations
what_it_shows: The Owner-Manager bought the motel in 2018, moved to the cloud PMS in 2019 and began scanning ID documents at check-in in 2021; signed the 2025 SAQ P2PE on the gateway sales representative's advice when the terminals were installed in 2024; handles hiring and departures; an economy brand's franchise proposal (June 2026) is deferred to 2027; the motel has no Illinois operations or employees, no California business, no federal contracts and no registered securities; CCTV has 10 cameras, keeps 21 days, is viewed on the Owner-Manager's phone and has no facial recognition

title: BIA interviews with process owners
source_system: Interviews (Owner-Manager, Assistant Manager, Night Auditor, Head Housekeeper, MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Each owner's description of their process, the systems, vendors and people it uses, its manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss they say it can tolerate; a walked guest costs about $150 in another motel's rate and goodwill; the locks keep working with existing cards if the lock system fails, staff hold mechanical override keys, and the lock vendor needs 1 to 2 days to rebuild the lock software

title: Risk assessment interviews
source_system: Interviews (Owner-Manager, Assistant Manager, both Front Desk Clerks, Night Auditor, Head Housekeeper, MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Owners' accounts of past events and near misses; the Owner-Manager showed the pricing tool's rate history for the 2025 hurricane evacuation: while the county was under a declared state of emergency, rates rose 61% above the 30-day average for 2 nights, and no complaint was received; staff do not give room numbers by phone by habit, with no written rule; the night shift works alone; the Owner-Manager's laptop is used at home and elsewhere; the Owner-Manager's phone hotspot is the only internet fallback; the MSP lead technician states its remote management platform requires MFA and reaches every PC, with no supporting evidence supplied

title: Front office and back office walkthrough, 2026-07-15
source_system: Motel front desk, back office and roadside sign (observation)
collected_by: Assistant Manager (Security and Privacy Lead), with the MSP lead technician
what_it_shows: Front desk staffed; front desk PC signed in to the shared Windows account; back office behind the desk locked and visible from the desk, with the network cabinet inside; keys held by the Owner-Manager, Assistant Manager and Night Auditor; vendor technicians and the handyman enter the back office with no log; 2 P2PE terminals on the counter with no device list or inspection record; crew billing binder unlocked under the front counter, holding printed card authorization forms from 2021 onward, a sample of which showed card security codes; cross-cut shredder in the back office; the lock vendor's remote support tool set to run at all times; CCTV recorder in the back office using its installer's administrator password, firmware page showing no update since installation in 2022, clock 9 minutes off; the roadside rate sign shows the base rate (photo)

title: P2PE solution listing check, 2026-07-15
source_system: PCI SSC list of validated P2PE solutions (website)
what_it_shows: The gateway's P2PE solution appears on the PCI SSC list of validated P2PE solutions

title: Shared mailbox search, 2026-07-16
what_it_shows: About 640 emails with card authorization forms since 2021, about 260 of them including the card security code; the forms arrive as ordinary email attachments and stay readable to anyone signed in to the shared mailbox

title: Firewall rule export and network scan, 2026-07-16
source_system: MSP firewall management; scan from the front desk PC by the MSP lead technician
collected_by: Assistant Manager (Security and Privacy Lead), with the MSP lead technician
what_it_shows: Inbound traffic blocked with no services exposed to the internet; outbound traffic unrestricted; no record of rule reviews; the scan from the front desk PC reached the back office PC, both terminals, the printer, the CCTV recorder and the tablets on one network

title: PMS permission, data count and register reports, 2026-07-16
what_it_shows: All 5 front office users hold the 'view full card number' permission; about 31,000 guest profiles since 2019 and about 14,000 ID images since 2021, none purged; the guest register report lists guests in chronological order with dates of occupancy and rates and can be printed at any time

title: Gateway AOC and P2PE Instruction Manual
what_it_shows: Service provider attestation of compliance dated January 2026; the P2PE Instruction Manual asks merchants to keep a device list, inspect devices periodically and train staff; neither document was on file before 2026-07-20

title: Website and website-builder account review, 2026-07-20
what_it_shows: The site is built from website-builder templates, takes no payments and links to the PMS vendor's booking page; no record of checks that the booking link still points to the vendor; the privacy statement says card details are 'processed securely by our payment partner and never stored by the motel'; the 'rates from' banner shows the base rate (screenshot); the website-builder account has no MFA

title: Test calls and booking engine test, 2026-07-21
source_system: 3 test phone calls to the front desk; booking engine
what_it_shows: In 3 test calls the clerk quoted the base rate and mentioned the $6 fee only when asked; the booking engine showed the total price including the fee, then taxes and the final amount before payment, and described the fee as covering Wi-Fi, parking and breakfast

title: Gateway confirmation email, 2026-07-21
what_it_shows: The gateway confirms that the motel's terminals connect through the P2PE solution using current TLS

title: Gap analysis interviews
source_system: Interviews (all 7 employees and the MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of how each PCI DSS requirement group, the FTC rules and the Florida rules are handled today: no written procedures for networks, configuration, card data, transmission, anti-malware, change, physical security, logging or testing; the MSP changes firewall rules and PCs on request by phone with no record; no log review, no monitoring of logging failures, no checks for unauthorized access points, no internal or external scans, no penetration test and no change detection; the motel develops no software; staff did not know the acquirer's 24-hour notice term or the card brands' deadlines

title: MSP evidence package for the control assessment
what_it_shows: July 2026 patch report showing monthly patching of the 3 PCs; antivirus console export for all devices; firewall rule export and log settings; device encryption report; backup job report, selection list and retention settings; the MSP confirmed that no restore test record exists; the technician list and the MSP security questionnaire were not received by fieldwork end

title: Backup job selection change record
source_system: Cloud backup service console (SYS-09); MSP ticket
what_it_shows: The lock software database folder was added to the nightly backup job selection on 2026-08-12; no restore of it has been run

title: Acquirer email on the 2026 validation approach
what_it_shows: The acquirer agrees to SAQ P2PE plus SAQ A for 2026 on condition that the redesign is complete before the attestation is signed, and to SAQ D if it is not complete by 2026-12-15

title: Pricing tool back-test and rate checks
source_system: Dynamic pricing tool change log 2025-03-01 to 2026-07-31; booking engine and phone quotes
what_it_shows: 14-day occupancy forecast error averaged 10.4%; 9 nights below the $62 break-even rate; during the 2025 hurricane evacuation rates rose 61% above the 30-day average for 2 nights while the county was under a declared state of emergency; nobody reviews the change log; a driver breakdown is shown for each date; 24 quotes for the same room and dates across devices, logged-in and anonymous sessions, English and Spanish pages and phone gave identical prices

title: Pricing tool vendor terms, questionnaire and interface field list
source_system: Subscription terms; vendor security questionnaire; PMS interface field list; tool account settings
what_it_shows: Terms: the vendor uses only the motel's own data and public listed rates and does not pool the motel's non-public data; the vendor answered a short security questionnaire and has no SOC 2 report; MFA available and off on the tool account; the interface carries occupancy, pickup and rate data and no guest names or contact details

title: OTA channel price check, 2026-08-21
what_it_shows: The booking engine and 2 of the 3 OTAs showed the total price including the $6 fee; one OTA showed the base rate in search results, and its channel feed does not carry the fee as mandatory

title: Control assessment: account management test
source_system: PMS, suite, gateway portal and lock system user lists and Windows accounts compared with the payroll roster (EV-001); Assistant Manager and MSP lead technician interviews
what_it_shows: Account types, approvals, procedures, notification rules and reviews are not documented; shared front desk Windows login and shared mailbox in use; the shared mailbox password has not changed since 2024 despite 3 departures; 2 former employees (left 2026-03 and 2026-05) still had active PMS accounts on 2026-08-04, with no sign-ins after their last day, and were disabled that day; the Owner-Manager handles departures and did not tell the Assistant Manager; each named PMS user has a role that matches intended use

title: Control assessment: card number display test
source_system: PMS permission report; test sign-in as a front office user
what_it_shows: All 5 front office users can display full OTA virtual card numbers; a test front office account displayed a full number on 2026-08-04

title: Control assessment: remote access test
source_system: Lock vendor remote support tool settings on the back office PC; connection request with the lock vendor on the phone; MSP remote management description; Assistant Manager and MSP interviews
what_it_shows: No usage restrictions, connection requirements or guidance documented for remote access; the lock vendor tool ran as an always-on service and accepted a connection request on 2026-08-04 with no prompt at the motel; the MSP set it to start only when the motel accepts a session on 2026-08-05

title: Control assessment: administrator MFA sign-in tests
source_system: Sign-in attempts to the firewall management page, gateway merchant portal and backup console (MSP present); PMS administrator settings
what_it_shows: Backup console and PMS administrator accounts required MFA; the firewall management login and the Assistant Manager's gateway portal login accepted a password alone

title: Control assessment: boundary protection test
source_system: Firewall rule export; network scan of 2026-07-16 (EV-050); guest Wi-Fi test from a guest room
what_it_shows: Unsolicited inbound traffic blocked and no services exposed; all external connections pass through the one firewall; guest Wi-Fi has client isolation and a guest-room test reached no office device; the office network is flat, and the scan reached both terminals, the CCTV recorder and the back office PC from the front desk PC; firewall logs kept about 7 days and not reviewed

title: Control assessment: malicious code protection test
source_system: MSP antivirus console export; harmless industry-standard test file on the front desk PC; after-hours test alert
what_it_shows: Antivirus on all 3 PCs and suite mail filtering detected the test file, which was quarantined automatically; signatures update automatically; weekly full scans and real-time scanning on; 2 false positives released by the MSP in July 2026; the after-hours test alert sent at 21:40 on 2026-08-04 was not seen by the MSP until 08:15 the next day; nobody at the motel receives alerts

title: Control assessment: vulnerability monitoring review
source_system: MSP contract and reports; acquirer portal; Assistant Manager and MSP interviews
what_it_shows: No internal or external (ASV) scans have been run and no scanning tool is in use; monitoring is limited to missing-patch reports for the 3 PCs; no remediation time limits defined; recorder firmware never updated

title: Control assessment: log review
source_system: PMS activity report; suite sign-in log; firewall log settings; Assistant Manager interview
what_it_shows: No log review or reporting is performed; the PMS activity report showed 41 full card number displays in July 2026 that nobody had looked at

title: Control assessment: training records and staff interviews
source_system: HR files; interviews with 5 of 7 employees
what_it_shows: No security or privacy training at hire or yearly; no reminders or phishing exercises; 2 of 5 staff interviewed said they would give a password to a caller from 'PMS support' if asked

title: Control assessment: backup configuration review
source_system: Backup job report (July 2026); backup job selection list; backup console settings (with the MSP)
what_it_shows: Back office PC user files and suite mailboxes and files are copied nightly, including the security documents in the suite file store; backups encrypted and the console requires MFA for named MSP technicians; the lock software database folder is excluded from the job selection; no restore test since setup in 2024; versions not immutable, with a 30-day window

title: Control assessment: card form media review
source_system: Front desk crew billing binder; MSP device policy; walkthroughs 2026-07-15 and 2026-08-04
what_it_shows: No digital media in use; USB storage blocked on the 3 PCs; the crew billing binder sat open under the front counter and held 410 forms, about 160 with security codes, kept since 2021 with none destroyed; the binder was moved to a locked drawer in the back office on 2026-08-05

title: Control assessment: provider oversight review
source_system: Vendor files; PMS vendor and gateway AOCs; MSP contract; lock vendor invoice terms; Owner-Manager interview
what_it_shows: No security or privacy requirements stated to the MSP or the lock vendor; no provider list or responsibility matrix; PMS vendor AOC on file and gateway AOC on file since 2026-07-20; the MSP questionnaire requested on 2026-07-27 was not returned by fieldwork end

title: Control assessment: incident reporting interviews
source_system: Interviews with 5 of 7 employees and the Owner-Manager; draft POL-03
what_it_shows: No reporting requirement in use; staff named three different people they would tell about an incident; nobody knew the acquirer notice term; POL-03 was a draft

title: Control assessment: component inventory test
source_system: MSP device list; walkthrough count of devices 2026-08-04
what_it_shows: The MSP list covers the 3 PCs only, with no duplicates; terminals, tablets, firewall, access points, recorder and lock encoder are not listed; terminal serial numbers, owners and locations are not recorded; the list has never been reviewed
